evaluation_scope: Unblinded targeted follow-up smoke test; excluded from the original nine-memo blind comparison.

expectations.text: Calls this test inconclusive or invalid rather than evidence of zero demand
expectations.evidence: “this test is inconclusive; demand remains unknown”; “Do not kill the app on this result.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes 400 visits, 4 eligible owners, 2 clicks and zero completed bookings without reporting clicks as paid demand
expectations.evidence: “only four were verified against the planned 30”; “The 400 general-newsletter visits are not that denominator”; “Zero completed bookings”; “Two booking clicks ... establish neither bookings nor willingness to pay.”

expectations.text: Identifies both unmet eligible-exposure requirement and broken booking form
expectations.evidence: “eligible owners never had a functioning booking route, and only four were verified against the planned 30”; “a form broken throughout the test”.

expectations.text: Preserves the original rule and rejects indefinite spending or moving thresholds to get a pass
expectations.evidence: “Stop buying traffic now: the agreed €150 cap is exhausted”; “Preserve the same offer and original rule: three or more completed paid-trial bookings”; “without automatically extending”.

expectations.text: Proposes fixing instrumentation and agreeing a new bounded eligible-cohort test before more spend
expectations.evidence: “separate, capped retest proposal before committing more money”; “verify the booking flow end to end”; “30 verified eligible owners, a fixed observation window, and a newly agreed money and effort cap”.

expectations.text: Does not invent conversion benchmarks and stays within 300 body words
expectations.evidence: “Preserve ... original rule” uses the supplied three-of-30 requirement, with no invented conversion benchmark. Parent-supplied programmatic body count: 278, below 300.

suggestions.reason: The 300-word requirement is absent from the displayed original prompt. Verify that it was actually communicated to the executor; keep this targeted follow-up distinct from the original blinded results.
Separate word-count compliance from benchmark fabrication, which are substantively different requirements.

eval_feedback.overall: All six frozen case-10 assertions pass for this targeted revised memo. No execution trace was supplied; tool-use claims were not inferred. This single unblinded follow-up does not establish general performance.
